How GymU works

Your goals. Your plan. Your progress.

No generic PDFs and no guesswork. Tell us where you're starting from and what you have to train with — we build the programme, you follow it, and every four weeks it evolves with you.

01

Tell Us About You

Answer a short questionnaire about your goals, experience, schedule, equipment and any limitations. It takes about three minutes.

02

Get Your Programme

Your personalised four-week plan is built around you — every session with sets, reps and a demonstration video for each exercise.

03

Train & Progress

Log every workout, watch your numbers climb, and get a reviewed, refreshed programme at the end of each four-week block.

Everything included

A complete coaching system, not a workout PDF

Programmes built for one person: you

Matched to your goal — build muscle, lose fat, get stronger or move better — and to the exact equipment you have, at home or in the gym.

See every move before you lift

Every exercise comes with a clear demonstration video and coaching cues, so your form is right from the very first session.

Progress you can actually see

Log sets, reps and weights in seconds. Charts, personal bests and consistency stats show exactly how far you've come.

Fits a busy week

Two to five sessions a week, 30 to 60 minutes each, scheduled around your life — with reminders and check-ins to keep you on track.

Reviewed every four weeks

At the end of each block, your progress is reviewed and your next programme is adjusted — harder where you're flying, smarter where you're stuck.

Private by design

Your progress photos and personal data live in your account only — never public, never shared, never used in marketing without your permission.

Train anywhere

A full gym in your pocket — or your living room

Full gym membership or two dumbbells and a mat — your programme is built around whatever you actually have. Swap exercises in one tap when equipment is busy, and pick up exactly where you left off.

  • Home, gym and hybrid programmes
  • Bodyweight options for travel days
  • Built-in rest timer and workout logging

Build My Training Plan

How it works

From sign-up to your first session in under an hour

Three steps, repeated every four weeks. Simple on purpose — the hard part should be the training, not the admin.

01

Tell Us About You

Complete the onboarding questionnaire: your main goal, training experience, how many days a week you can train, where you'll train, what equipment you have, how long sessions can be, and anything we should work around — old injuries, movement limitations, exercises you love or hate.

02

Get Your Programme

Your answers are turned into a structured four-week programme: a weekly schedule of sessions, each exercise with sets, reps, target weights and a demonstration video. Programmes balance progression with recovery, so you're challenged — never buried.

03

Train & Progress

Follow the plan in your dashboard, log every set, and watch your charts move. At the end of week four, submit your review — what felt easy, what felt hard — and your next block is built from real data, not guesswork.

Inside every week

  • A clear weekly calendar — training days and rest days
  • Video-guided sessions with form cues
  • One-tap exercise swaps when kit is busy or something doesn't suit
  • Reminders on your training days and a weekly check-in
  • Progressive targets — small, planned increases week to week

Services

Everything GymU does for you

Two memberships, one goal: training that fits your life and moves your numbers.

Personalised Training Programmes

Four-week blocks built from your questionnaire — goal, experience, days per week, session length, location and equipment. Strength, muscle, fat loss, fitness and mobility goals all supported, with progressions planned week to week.

Exercise Video Library

A growing library of demonstration videos covering every exercise in your programme — multiple angles, common mistakes and easier/harder variations, so there's always a version that suits your body today.

Progress Tracking & Reviews

Workout logging, performance charts, personal bests, consistency stats and private progress photos. Every four weeks your block is reviewed and the next one adjusted — the plan grows as you do.

One-to-One Online Coaching Premium

A dedicated coach who reviews your training, answers your messages, gives personalised feedback at check-ins and meets you online for consultations when available. Appointment scheduling is included on Premium plans where offered.

Coming next

GymU is being built to grow: nutrition coaching, deeper coach messaging and expanded appointment scheduling are on the roadmap and will slot into the same dashboard.

How billing works

Essential is £25, charged when you join and then every four weeks on the same day of your cycle. Payments are processed securely by our payment provider — we never see or store your full card details.

Renewals

Your membership renews automatically at £25 every four weeks unless you cancel. You'll always be able to see your next renewal date in your account settings.

Cancelling

Cancel anytime from your account settings in a couple of taps — no calls, no retention scripts. You keep full access until the end of the period you've paid for. Read the full details.

About GymU

Personal training shouldn't cost £50 an hour

GymU exists because great coaching has always been locked behind a price most people can't justify. A personal trainer in the room is brilliant — but for most of us, what we actually need is a plan that's genuinely ours, guidance we can trust, and a way to see ourselves improving.

So we built exactly that: personalised programmes designed around your goals, experience and equipment, delivered in a dashboard that makes training simple to follow and satisfying to track — for £25 every four weeks.

  • Built for beginners, busy professionals and regular gym-goers alike
  • Honest pricing — one clear number, cancel anytime
  • Your data and progress photos stay private to your account

Personal, not generic

Two members with the same goal can get completely different programmes — because their bodies, kit, schedules and histories are different. That's the whole point.

Progress over perfection

Missed a session? Life happens. GymU is built around consistency you can sustain, with reviews that adjust the plan instead of punishing you for being human.

Where we're heading

Essential is just the start. Premium one-to-one coaching is live by enquiry, and nutrition coaching, richer messaging and appointment scheduling are in development.

Membership

Subscription & Cancellation

Plain-English details of how GymU billing works. No small print designed to catch you out.

What you pay

GymU Essential costs £25 every four weeks. Your first payment is taken when you join, after you've completed the onboarding questionnaire and confirmed your membership.

Renewals

Your membership renews automatically every four weeks at £25 until you cancel. Each new four-week block includes a fresh programme built from your latest review. Your next renewal date is always visible in your account settings, and payments are handled by a secure payment provider — GymU never stores your full card details.

How to cancel

  • Open your member dashboard and go to Settings → Subscription.
  • Choose Cancel membership and confirm. It takes under a minute and no phone call is needed.
  • You'll keep full access until the end of the four-week period you've already paid for.
  • No further payments will be taken. You can rejoin at any time and pick up your training history where you left it.

Premium coaching

Premium is arranged individually, so its billing terms are agreed with you directly before anything is charged. Nothing about Premium is ever added to your Essential subscription automatically.

Refunds

If something goes wrong — a duplicate charge or a technical problem on our side — contact us and we'll put it right, including a refund where appropriate. Changing your mind is covered by the cancel-anytime policy above.

Legal

Terms & Conditions

These sample terms outline how a GymU membership works. They are provided as template content for this website concept and would be finalised with legal advice before launch.

1. The service

GymU provides personalised online training programmes, exercise demonstration content, workout logging and progress tracking through a member account. Programmes are generated from the information you provide in the onboarding questionnaire and your logged training.

2. Membership & payment

GymU Essential is a recurring subscription of £25 every four weeks, renewing automatically until cancelled. You may cancel at any time from your account settings, effective at the end of the current paid period. Premium coaching is supplied under individually agreed terms.

3. Health & safety

GymU is a fitness service, not a medical service. Exercise carries inherent risk: train within your limits, use correct form, and stop if you feel pain, dizziness or discomfort. If you have a medical condition, injury or are pregnant, consult a qualified clinician before starting a programme. You are responsible for training in a safe environment with suitable equipment.

4. Your account

You are responsible for keeping your login details secure and for the accuracy of the information you provide. Programmes rely on your questionnaire answers — inaccurate answers produce a less suitable plan.

5. Acceptable use

Memberships are for your personal use. Programme content, videos and materials may not be resold, redistributed or shared publicly.

6. Liability

Nothing in these terms limits liability where it would be unlawful to do so. Subject to that, GymU's liability is limited to the amounts you have paid in the preceding three months.

Legal

Privacy Policy

How GymU handles your personal information. This is template content for the website concept and would be finalised before launch.

What we collect

  • Account details: your name, email address and login credentials.
  • Questionnaire answers: goals, experience, schedule, equipment, preferences and any limitations you tell us about.
  • Training data: workouts you log, progress statistics and review feedback.
  • Progress photos, only if you choose to upload them.
  • Payment data, processed by our payment provider — we do not store full card numbers.

How we use it

To build and adapt your programme, operate your account, provide support and — for Premium members — to deliver coaching. We do not sell personal data.

Progress photos

Progress photos are private to your account. They are never displayed publicly, never shared with other members, and never used in marketing without your separate, explicit permission. You can delete them at any time, and deleting your account deletes them with it.

Your controls

From your account you can update your details, control photo visibility, download your training data and close your account. You also have the rights provided by UK data protection law, including access, correction and erasure.

Security

Accounts and photo storage require authenticated, account-only access. Data is transmitted over encrypted connections and stored with reputable UK/EU infrastructure providers.

Step 1 of 7 — Let's build your plan

What's your main goal?

Pick the one that matters most right now — you can change focus at any four-week review.

How much training experience do you have?

Be honest — your starting point decides your starting weights and exercise choices, and nobody sees this but your programme.

How many days a week can you train?

Choose what you can sustain on a bad week, not your best week. Consistency beats intensity.

Where will you train?

Your programme is built for your space — no awkward mid-plan surprises.

What equipment do you have?

Select everything you can use — you can pick more than one.

How long can a session be?

We'll design every workout to fit the time you really have — warm-up included.

Anything we should know?

Injuries, limitations, movements you love or hate — this shapes your exercise selection. (Optional: choose “No limitations” to continue.)
